items.source: Return a composed request predicate that tests against both this predicate AND the other predicate (String processed as a path predicate). When evaluating the composed predicate, if this predicate is false, then the other predicate is not evaluated.
items.translation: 返回一个组合请求谓词，该谓词针对此谓词 AND 其他 谓词进行测试（String 作为路径谓词处理）。在评估组合谓词时，如果此谓词为 false，则不评估 其他 谓词。
